title: Colors not as vivid as those posted in the photos here :(
text: Colors not as vivid as those posted in the photos here :(. I like it but the colors seem a bit dull compared to another rug also from nuLoom that we bought around the same time.  The colors definitely look brighter and more defined in the photos here than in real life...a bummer but returning it would be a huge mess so we kept it.

Stylish and versatile, this global-inspired rug adds the right amount of chic to your space
Easy to clean and maintain, we recommend vacuuming regularly and spot treating any mild stains with carpet cleaner
